events.title: The Kalmar Union breaks
events.text: King Christopher of Bavaria has died without an heir. The Swedish council elects Karl Knutsson Bonde king, while the Danes look to Count Christian of Oldenburg.

options.text: Let Sweden go its own way
Insist on one king for the three crowns

events.title: Death of Shah Rukh
events.text: Shah Rukh, Timur's son, has died on campaign. His grandsons and Ulugh Beg in Samarkand fight over the inheritance, and Jahan Shah of the Kara Koyunlu marches on Persian Iraq.

options.text: The princes fight for the throne
Ulugh Beg holds the empire together

events.title: The Golden Ambrosian Republic
events.text: Filippo Maria Visconti, last of his line, has died. The nobles and jurists of Milan proclaim a republic in the name of Saint Ambrose, while the condottiero Francesco Sforza, the duke's son-in-law, waits with his army.

events.title: Sforza enters Milan
events.text: Besieged and starving, Milan opens its gates to Francesco Sforza, who is acclaimed duke.

events.title: The Tumu Crisis
events.text: Esen Taishi's Oirat horsemen have destroyed the imperial army at Tumu fortress and captured the Zhengtong emperor. Yu Qian urges the court to enthrone the emperor's brother and defend Beijing.

options.text: Enthrone a new emperor and defend Beijing
Ransom the emperor at any price

events.title: The Truce of Tours is broken
events.text: English soldiers have sacked the Breton town of Fougères. Charles VII's new standing companies stand ready to retake Normandy.

events.title: Formigny and Castillon
events.text: French cannon have broken the English at Formigny and at Castillon, where Talbot fell. Normandy and Gascony are lost to the English crown; only Calais remains.

options.text: Take Normandy and Gascony and make peace
Carry the war across the Channel

events.title: The Wars of the Roses
events.text: Richard of York and the Nevilles have defeated the king's men at St Albans. The houses of Lancaster and York arm their retainers.

options.text: Civil war between Lancaster and York

events.title: Gutenberg's press
events.text: In Mainz, Johannes Gutenberg prints books with movable metal type. Within a generation presses run in every great city of Europe.

events.title: Mehmed II besieges Constantinople
events.text: Sultan Mehmed has built Rumeli Hisarı on the Bosporus and cast great bombards. He means to take the City.

events.title: The fall of Constantinople
events.text: After fifty-three days the walls of Theodosius are breached. Constantine XI has died fighting, and the sultan rides to Hagia Sophia.

options.text: Take the City and leave the Morea to the despots
Press on to the Morea as well

events.title: The Prussian Confederation
events.text: The towns and knights of Prussia have renounced the Teutonic Order and offered their allegiance to King Casimir.

options.text: Accept the Prussians and declare war on the Order

events.title: The Second Peace of Thorn
events.text: Bankrupt and beaten, the Teutonic Order sues for peace: Pomerelia, Chełmno and Marienburg will become Royal Prussia under the Polish crown.

events.title: The Ōnin War
events.text: The Hosokawa and Yamana have gone to war over the shogunal succession, and Kyoto burns. Provincial lords cease to obey the shogun.

options.text: The country falls into warring provinces

events.title: Isabella marries Ferdinand
events.text: Princess Isabella, heir of Castile, has secretly married Ferdinand, heir of Aragon, at Valladolid.

events.title: The Catholic Monarchs
events.text: King John II of Aragon has died. Ferdinand inherits Aragon, and with Isabella rules both crowns of Spain.

events.title: The Granada War
events.text: Granada's emir has seized the Castilian town of Zahara. The Catholic Monarchs resolve to finish the Reconquista.

events.title: The fall of Granada
events.text: Boabdil has handed the keys of the Alhambra to Ferdinand and Isabella. The last Muslim state in Iberia is gone.

events.title: Columbus sails west
events.text: Cristoforo Colombo, a Genoese navigator, asks the crown for ships to reach the Indies by sailing west across the Ocean Sea.

events.title: Vasco da Gama reaches India
events.text: Vasco da Gama's ships have rounded the Cape of Good Hope and anchored off Calicut. The sea road to the spices of the Indies lies open.

options.text: Send armed fleets to the Indies

events.title: Lord Novgorod the Great
events.text: After the defeat on the Shelon, Novgorod's boyars look to Lithuania. Ivan III demands that the city submit to the sovereign of all Rus'.

options.text: Annex Novgorod and carry off its veche bell

events.title: The Great Stand on the Ugra
events.text: Khan Akhmat of the Great Horde has marched to the Ugra river to restore Moscow's tribute. Ivan III's army holds the fords.

options.text: Hold the river and pay nothing

events.title: The Burgundian Wars
events.text: Charles the Bold of Burgundy threatens Lorraine and the Upper Rhine. Bern and its confederates, paid by Louis XI, declare war.

events.title: Death of Charles the Bold
events.text: Duke Charles has fallen before Nancy. Louis XI seizes the duchy of Burgundy and Picardy; Duchess Mary marries Maximilian of Austria to keep the Netherlands.

events.title: The Burgundian inheritance
events.text: Maximilian of Habsburg has married Mary of Burgundy. Through her, the rich Netherlands pass to the House of Austria.
